latest_update.text: Salam, Step 1 (live): post-fulfillment check-in email, sent 1 week after order status hits "fulfilled," asking how the meat arrived and if they've tried it yet. Step 2 (to confirm/build): reactivation email for first-time and repeat customers who haven't reordered in 2 months , offering the SECONDS10 10% discount code. Framed as a friendly check-in, not a hard sell. Decision context: deliberately spaced out (not asking to repurchase too soon) so the cadence feels like genuine relationship-building, not a sales push. @Sohib Boundaoui
